intent_en: To explain how the yield curve functions as an economic indicator and why an inversion signals a potential economic slowdown.
previous_intent: To explain the mechanics of the yield curve and how an inversion in interest rates between short-term and long-term bonds signals investor expectations of an economic slowdown.
narration_support: what is it about this curve that seems to make it such a good indicator of where the economy is heading?
chart_support: Line chart titled 'Yield curve' comparing 'Normal' and 'Inverted' curves, plotting 'Interest rate' against 'Time' (3m to 10y).
evidence_note: The narration explicitly asks about the curve's predictive power and explains the mechanism of inversion (long-term rates dropping below short-term rates due to fear of slowing economy), while the chart visualizes the 'Normal' (upward sloping) and 'Inverted' (downward sloping) relationships between interest rates and time.
